ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
(function(){
  var out=new Packages.java.util.ArrayList();
  var collect=function(html){
    if(!html)return;
    java.setContent(String(html));
    var list=java.getElements('#article_list_content li');
    if(list){for(var i=0;i<list.size();i++)out.add(list.get(i));}
  };
  collect(String(result||''));
  var key=String(java.get('penrixTwkanKey')||'');
  var alt=String(java.s2t(key)||'');
  if(alt && alt!==key){
    var cfg=JSON.stringify({method:'POST',body:'searchkey='+java.encodeURI(alt)+'&searchtype=all',charset:'utf8'});
    try{collect(String(java.ajax('https://twkan.com/search,'+cfg)||''));}catch(e){}
  }
  return out;
})()
</js>

ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
var Normalizer=Packages.java.text.Normalizer;
var Form=Packages.java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFKC;
var cleaned=String(result||'').split(/\r?\n/).filter(function(line){
  var normalized=String(Normalizer.normalize(String(line),Form)).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  if(!normalized)return true;
  if(/[記记]住本站域名/i.test(normalized))return false;
  if(/GOOGLE\s*搜索\s*TWKAN/i.test(normalized))return false;
  if(/把本網(?:站)?分享到/i.test(normalized)||/把本网站分享到/i.test(normalized))return false;
  if(/台[灣湾](?:小說網|小说网).*twkan\.com/i.test(normalized))return false;
  if(/^(?:www\.)?(?:twkan|69shux)\.com$/i.test(normalized))return false;
  if(/^本章完[。.!！]?$/.test(normalized))return false;
  return true;
}).join('\n');
java.t2s(cleaned);
</js>
